name: storefast
description: Check on and update the Windows apps you sell in the Microsoft Store: stats, reviews, certification status and your Store listing.

interface.longDescription:
StoreFast connects ChatGPT to your StoreFast account, so you can check on and update the Windows apps you sell in the Microsoft Store by asking.

Ask how an app did this month and you get its downloads, installs, revenue and ratings, the change from the period before, and its top markets. Read the newest reviews in English, translated when they were written in another language, and filter them by stars, market or date. See where an update stands in certification, why one failed, and whether it's waiting for you to press Publish in Partner Center.

You can also edit your Store listing in any language: the title, descriptions, features, search terms, screenshot captions and notes for certification. StoreFast can fill in missing languages in your app's writing style and suggest search terms. Edits are saved as a draft you can check on storefast.app. When you ask to send listing changes or submit an update to Microsoft, ChatGPT shows you what will go out and waits for your yes.

You need a StoreFast account with your Microsoft Partner Center account connected. StoreFast only sees the apps in the account you sign in with. When you sign in, you choose whether ChatGPT can only read or can also make changes. To publish an update, ask, then upload the new app package on the storefast.app page ChatGPT links to.
capabilities: Show Microsoft Store downloads, installs, revenue and ratings
Read and summarize Store reviews in English
Edit the Store listing in every language
Send listing updates and submit app updates after you approve
defaultPrompt: How did my apps do in the Microsoft Store over the last 30 days?
Summarize the low-star reviews of my app from the last month.
Is my latest update live in the Microsoft Store yet?

positive.description: Stats for the account's apps over a range, with the change from the period before.
positive.prompt: How did my apps do in the Microsoft Store over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's two example apps, Larkspur Notes and Copperline Ruler, and reports each one's downloads, installs and revenue for the last 30 days, the percent change against the 30 days before, and its top markets. No numbers are invented.

positive.description: Summarize low-rated reviews, treating review text as data.
positive.prompt: Summarize the 1 and 2 star reviews of Larkspur Notes from the last 90 days.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls list_reviews with rating filters and a since date, then summarizes the common complaints in English. If there are none in that range, it says so.

positive.description: Certification status of the latest update.
positive.prompt: Is my latest update live in the Microsoft Store yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the version live in the Store and the status of the latest update from StoreFast or Partner Center for each app, or says an app has no updates from StoreFast yet.

positive.description: Edit the listing draft without sending anything to Microsoft.
positive.prompt: Add "Works offline" as a feature in the English Store listing of Larkspur Notes, then tell me if anything would block sending it.
positive.expected_behavior: After the person confirms the edit, saves the new feature in the listing draft and reports any problems that block sending. It says nothing was sent to Microsoft yet.

positive.description: Search term ideas that leave the listing unchanged.
positive.prompt: Suggest a few new search terms for the English listing of Copperline Ruler.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 10 search term ideas that aren't in the listing yet and explains that the listing wasn't changed. It asks which terms to save and saves them with update_listing.

negative.description: Deleting an app from the Store isn't something StoreFast can do.
negative.prompt: Delete my app from the Microsoft Store.

negative.description: Apps outside the signed-in account aren't visible.
negative.prompt: Show me the latest reviews of Microsoft Word.

negative.description: Replying to reviews isn't something StoreFast can do.
negative.prompt: Reply to the newest 1-star review of Larkspur Notes.

review.commerce_description: StoreFast doesn't sell anything in ChatGPT. People sign in to an existing StoreFast account.

publication.release_notes: First release: Microsoft Store stats, reviews, certification status, Store listing editing and translation, and sending listing changes and app updates after the person approves.
